title: Shibuya Scramble Crossing
summary: Steer an orange coupe across rain-slick zebra stripes in Shibuya. Drag to drive and release to brake as 180 pedestrians part around the car, then drift back into the crossing.
summaryZhTW: 霓虹倒映在澀谷雨後的斑馬線上。拖曳指尖，駕著橘色跑車穿過路口，放開即可煞車。180 位行人隨車靠近而讓開，車過後又匯入人潮。
coverAlt: An orange sports car rounds a bend between crowds on a neon-lit Shibuya crosswalk.
controls: Press and drag with the mouse or touch to steer. Release to brake. With the crossing focused, use the arrow keys to steer. Pause and resume with the on-screen button.

approval.note: Creator requested cover artwork and a Games catalog entry.
